title: Gravity Rule
description: Applies constant downward acceleration to dynamic bodies, grounding movement and projectiles. Recorded facts — Rule: Gravity Rule; Scope: global physics; Effect: predictable falling and jumping. Used by game designers, simulation engineers, and metaverse builders to keep worlds consistent and fair.
demo:
# Gravity Rule — runnable demo (python3)
# Gravity Rule - spawn simulation (python3)
rate=3
cap=40
ticks=30
pop=0
for t in range(ticks):
    pop=min(cap, pop+rate)
print("population after %d ticks: %d (cap %d)" % (ticks, pop, cap))
print("STABLE" if pop <= cap else "OVERPOPULATED")
